brand_vibe.description: The business's own consistent photo watermark (present on nearly every Booksy 'inspiration' photo and every recent Instagram post) is a gold/champagne cursive 'SW' monogram with 'SHINE WORLD BY. ZULY LOPEZ' in thin tracked caps underneath, set on a near-black background, sometimes with a faux-fur white backdrop and small gold sparkle/star graphics. This reads as a glam, boutique, night-energy brand identity distinct from a soft daytime aesthetic. The actual nail-art photography spans a very wide, vivid color range (red/gold Valentine hearts, pink rhinestone florals, teal/white 3D beach-theme with pearls and gold shells, yellow/pink glitter florals, burgundy/gold marble abstracts), and the hair-color work shown includes striking fashion colors (vivid magenta-red, silver/gray) alongside sleek natural-black finishes. Conclusion: a DARK base (matching the brand's own black-backdrop watermark and glam energy) with a warm gold/rose-bronze accent reads truest to the brand, distinct from the cooler bronze of mizu or the rose-gold of jazzedbyjnicole.
brand_vibe.palette_name: shineworldzuly (warm gold and rose-bronze glam on near-black, new palette, does not reuse mizu/amani/mare/alea/pausa/slaybytay/jazzedbyjnicole)

language_evidence: Instagram bio is in Spanish/Spanglish ('You Shine World', service list in English words but the appointment call-to-action and virtually all 12 recent post captions are written entirely in Spanish: 'Blanco simple & elegante', 'Ella queria Un maquillaje suave', 'El corte del momento', 'Miren esa limpieza de cuticula', 'Un corte necesario', 'Que todo fluya segun su volundad', 'Seguimos confiando en los planes que Dios me tiene', 'Ella las queria cuadradas pero no cuadradas'). Booksy's own service menu and descriptions are overwhelmingly in Spanish (category names 'Unas', service names like 'Cirugia capilar', 'Botox Capilar', 'Aplicacion de color de cabello', 'Corte de puntas', 'Prueba de mechon y consulta', 'Sacado de cejas con Wax', 'Wax de Bozo', 'Waxing de Barbilla', plus Spanish service descriptions like 'Cirugia Capilar, ayuda a restaurar, suavizar las ondas y rizo del cabello'). Of the 10 Booksy reviews returned, most are in Spanish ('Love it muy buen trabajo y muy amable', 'tremendas manos! ame su trabajo', 'Excelente servicio. 100% recomendada') with 2 in English. Lakeland, FL (Polk County) has a large Spanish-speaking population. Spanish registered as the primary language; the site is fully bilingual (ES default, EN toggle) per pipeline requirement.

images_downloaded.sources: 19 images (logo, cover, 9 bizPhoto, 8 inspiration) came from the Booksy business photo payload (images.logo/cover/bizPhoto/inspiration in the resolved Nuxt data) via cloudfront URLs, curl with Chrome UA. 11 service-linked photos came from the per-service 'photos' arrays in the same Booksy payload. 12 images came from Instagram's own web_profile_info feed for @shineworld.zuly (6 GraphImage display_url + 6 GraphVideo poster display_url, no carousels in the recent window; every single one carries the business's own gold/white SW watermark, confirming they are genuinely the business's own posted content). All files verified with `file` as valid JPEGs, none 0 bytes or corrupted.
images_downloaded.curation_note: Visual curation performed image-by-image with the Read/vision tool, not by filename. EXCLUDED from gallery entirely: a face-closeup before/after makeup collage (booksy cover photo and a matching Instagram post) kept out of the gallery per the hard rule against closeup face photos in gallery tiles, even though both are legitimate finished-makeup demonstrations, not mid-procedure shots; a large logo/galaxy-graphic promotional image with big text overlay (excluded as a caption-over-photo); an Instagram post with a burned-in caption 'Aqui amamos la limpieza de cuticula' (excluded, text superimposed on the photo); a close-up sole-of-foot pedicure photo (excluded as an unappealing/unflattering crop, not a usable marketing image); an Instagram post featuring Disney 'Ariel' mermaid nail decals (excluded for third-party IP/trademark reasons, same precedent as excluding counterfeit-logo nail art in a prior build). The consistent brand watermark seen on nearly all other real photos (a small gold/white 'SW Shine World by Zuly Lopez' corner mark) was treated as the business's own deliberate branding, not a prohibited caption, and photos carrying only that watermark were used freely. No owner selfie or personal portrait was found in any source, so no avatar is used anywhere on the site.

research_note: Research performed 2026-07-19. Address, rating/review count, hours and full 29-item service menu cross-verified across two independent structured-data sources on the same live Booksy page (schema.org JSON-LD and the embedded Nuxt payload), which agreed on every overlapping field. Instagram web_profile_info API worked on the first attempt for @shineworld.zuly (the handle given in the task brief), confirmed live and matching the business exactly; note that Booksy's own sameAs field points to a different, unverified handle (youshine_world), which is called out above but not used. No own domain found (5 domain variants tested, all non-resolving; Booksy's own website field is null). No phone number and no public email found despite exhausting every source in the pipeline's checklist.
